title: LOGOS ASF — TR-04D Training Ingress Record (DEP.KEYSTONE + GovSec)
description: Constitutional data contract for Abigail-side training-source ingress records. Captures DEP.KEYSTONE supply-chain trust-bundle evidence (from LogosGSInc/dep.keystone) and GovSec V2 training admissibility decisions. DEP.KEYSTONE is a standalone LOGOS product; Abigail references its outputs, not redefines them.

dep_keystone_ingress_id.description: Stable Abigail-side identifier for this ingress record. Format: DKI-<descriptor>-<seq>.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this ingress record was created.

source_id.description: Source registry ID of the artifact being cleared (e.g., L1-001).

source_name.description: Human-readable name of the artifact being cleared.

classification.description: Handling classification for this ingress record.

dep_keystone_project_name.description: Name of the DEP.KEYSTONE project that produced the trust bundle. Typically LogosGSInc/dep.keystone.

dep_keystone_status.description: DEP.KEYSTONE verification outcome. VERIFIED means the supply-chain trust check passed. FAILED means it did not.

dep_keystone_trust_score.description: DEP.KEYSTONE trust score (0-100). Scores below 70 require HAAP DRS escalation and block training pipeline entry.

dep_keystone_findings_count.description: Number of findings reported by DEP.KEYSTONE. Informational; zero findings expected for clean artifacts.

dep_keystone_haap_drs_escalation_require.description: Whether DEP.KEYSTONE requires HAAP v2.0 Dynamic Risk Score escalation before this source may enter the training pipeline. Set to true by DEP.KEYSTONE when trust_score < 70.

dep_keystone_verification_report_ref.description: Reference (URI, path, or ID) to the verification-report.json produced by DEP.KEYSTONE for this artifact.

dep_keystone_evidence_sha256_ref.description: Reference (URI, path, or ID) to the evidence.sha256 file produced by DEP.KEYSTONE for this artifact.

dep_keystone_sbom_ref.description: Reference (URI, path, or ID) to the sbom.cdx.json (CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM) produced by DEP.KEYSTONE for this artifact.

dep_keystone_trust_cert_ref.description: Reference (URI, path, or ID) to the DEP.KEYSTONE TrustCert envelope for this artifact.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the artifact being cleared. Computed by Abigail; must be non-empty for approved records.

govsec_admissibility_status.description: GovSec V2 / Abigail training-admissibility lifecycle status. Only 'approved' permits training pipeline entry.

govsec_admissibility_decision.description: GovSec V2 / Abigail admissibility decision. Only 'accepted_for_clearance' permits pipeline entry.

govsec_layer.description: GovSec V2 layer classification for this ingress record.

reality_formation_input.description: Whether this artifact is a reality-formation input under GovSec V2 / Layer Zero doctrine.

ingress_actor_id.description: Identifier of the operator or system that submitted this ingress record.

operator_review_required.description: Whether operator review of this record is required before pipeline use.

training_pipeline_allowed.description: Whether the artifact may enter the training pipeline.

allowed_next_gates.description: Training pipeline gates this cleared artifact may enter.

x-invariants.dep_keystone_is_standalone_product: DEP.KEYSTONE is LogosGSInc/dep.keystone — a standalone supply-chain trust product. Abigail references its outputs; Abigail does not redefine, duplicate, or vendor DEP.KEYSTONE.
x-invariants.dep_keystone_outputs_are_refs: dep_keystone_verification_report_ref, dep_keystone_evidence_sha256_ref, dep_keystone_sbom_ref are references to DEP.KEYSTONE outputs — not re-computed hashes.
x-invariants.verified_required_for_clearance: dep_keystone_status must be VERIFIED for clearance. FAILED is a terminal block.
x-invariants.trust_score_gate: dep_keystone_trust_score < 70 requires HAAP DRS escalation and blocks training pipeline entry.
x-invariants.haap_escalation_blocks_pipeline: dep_keystone_haap_drs_escalation_required=true blocks training pipeline entry regardless of other fields.
x-invariants.govsec_approved_required: govsec_admissibility_status=approved and govsec_admissibility_decision=accepted_for_clearance are required for pipeline entry.
x-invariants.dep_keystone_does_not_replace_registry: source_registry_cleared and ledger_cleared belong to the dry-run envelope validation_summary, not to this ingress record.
x-invariants.no_duplicate_system: This schema introduces the TR-04D bridge where none previously existed. Do not create a parallel system.
